title: Year boundary: 'Monday the 11th' said on 30 December
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Says 'the week after next'. When asked for the exact day, says Monday the 11th. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: agent asks once for the exact day
the date is read as Monday 11 January 2027, not a day in 2026
promise recorded for 11 January 2027, inside the early-band deadline of 18 January
